gamerule.ocwo.fluid_displacement_limit.d: Maximum distance for fluids to find the way out when block placed in (0 = no displacement)
gamerule.ocwo.water_hot_fluid_evaporatio: Water evaporation upon contact with lava
Number of layers that will evaporate (0 = no evaporation)
gamerule.ocwo.farmland_water_intake.desc: Farmland consumes water, farmland also need to be connected with dirt-like block with water (0 = no consumption, -1 = vanilla behavior)
gamerule.ocwo.bucket_area_pickup.descrip: true (AREA): a bucket used on a block that is not full also takes water from the connected blocks around it on the same layer (up to 16 blocks, 4 blocks away), until full. false (COLUMN): only the targeted block and the block below it (PhysEx behaviour)
gamerule.ocwo.pressure_flow_max.descript: Water under pressure flows faster when the difference of height is larger (square root: 1 block x1, 4 blocks x2, 9 blocks x3, 16 blocks x4). This is the maximum speed-up, in levels per tick and per block of opening. 1 = no speed-up
ocwo.debug.command: OCWO debug information is now in the F3 screen (F3+F6 to choose the OCWO lines: ocwo_water_at_head, ocwo_looking_at, ocwo_simulation).
ocwo.debug.head.pressure: Pressure: %s blocks (%s levels) below the surface at y=%s
ocwo.debug.body.incomplete: Water body: over %s columns, analysis incomplete (retried later)
ocwo.debug.body.pending: Water body: transfers pending, low point y=%s (%s columns)
ocwo.debug.block.pending_release: %s moisture units waiting to be released as water
ocwo.debug.block.permeability: Permeability: down %s, up %s, N %s, S %s, E %s, W %s
ocwo.debug.sim.queues: Moisture random ticks last tick: %s, bodies of water with work: %s
ocwo.debug.sim.quotas: Water simulation distance: %s chunks, bodies of water: %s (%s columns)
ocwo.debug.sim.limits: Last tick: %s bodies worked, %s levels moved by pressure, deferred work: %s, speed-up max x%s
gamerule.ocwo.water_pressure.description: Hydraulic pressure: connected vessels reach the same level, tunnels fill completely, water rises in fountains
Distance around players where water is simulated (flow, pressure, moisture), in chunks. -1 = the server simulation distance. Beyond it, water is frozen and nothing is lost. Every tick does all the water work in this area: lower it if the game lags
ocwo.water.rest: %s awake water blocks put back at rest within %s chunks
ocwo.water.info: %s awake water blocks within %s chunks (all other water is at rest); water reserve of this zone: %s levels, clouds: %s levels
gamerule.ocwo.water_rest.description: The water of the world generation is not simulated (flow, pressure, moisture) until something disturbs it: a block changed next to it wakes it up, and the awakening spreads as far as the water moves
ocwo.debug.head.reserve: OCWO water reserve of the zone: %s levels, clouds: %s levels
gamerule.ocwo.moisture_random_ticks.desc: Blocks drawn at random every tick in each chunk section that holds disturbed moisture (like randomTickSpeed for crops). Higher: blocks soak up and dry faster. 0 = moisture frozen
ocwo.water.ledger.zone: Water ledger of zone %s, %s (blocks %s, %s to %s, %s), %s/16 chunks loaded:
ocwo.water.ledger.stocks: visible water %s levels, block moisture %s levels, reserve %s levels, clouds %s levels
ocwo.water.ledger.total: total: %s units (%s levels). It only changes when water crosses the edge of the zone or a chunk loads
gamerule.ocwo.moisture_evaporation.descr: Percent of each moisture transfer (water soaked up by a block, moisture passed to a neighbour) that evaporates into the clouds of the zone, in a temperate biome: half in cold biomes, up to 3.5 times more in hot, dry ones. 0 = none
gamerule.ocwo.reservoir_min_blocks.descr: A body of natural water at rest with at least this many blocks is one tank: the water taken from it comes off its surface, which goes down evenly, without waking the whole body. Smaller bodies flow normally. 0 = no reservoirs
